air.actions: Two to four night/early-morning reconnaissance or harassment sorties and a few dispersed fighter/water-air movements occur. No coherent strike package can be assembled against the invasion fleet.
air.composition_note: Most survivors are dispersed reconnaissance, water-air or local-defense assets; only a very small number of attack aircraft remain serviceable.

sensor_C2.target_islands: Kwajalein/Roi main tactical radar/director network is effectively destroyed as an atoll-wide battle-management system. Visual posts, runners, isolated phone segments and small radio/DF nodes continue local warning until overrun.
sensor_C2.outer_nodes: Maloelap, Wotje, Jaluit and other outer nodes continue to observe and report US movements. They provide operational warning to higher command but cannot restore tactical control on the assaulted islands.

submarines.useful_geometry_start: About 5-7 boats retain useful or near-useful geometry around transport/support approaches after previous attrition and diversions.
submarines.center_action: One boat obtains a marginal firing opportunity against a screened support/transport element but the solution is stale and/or crossing; four-to-six torpedoes produce no confirmed hit. A second boat is forced off by air/escort ASW before reaching weapon-quality geometry.
submarines.attrition: One boat incurs damage or crew/equipment degradation producing roughly 24-48 hours local unavailability; no additional submarine sinking is forced on the centerline.
submarines.T24_useful_geometry: Roughly 4-5 boats remain useful or near-useful around the wider atoll approaches.
